what.action: Phase 8 Phase B landed — verifyOrgAuthorization + authorized_by leaf shape on credential-kind envelopes (commit a319ad6).
what.summary: AuthorizedByPayload + encode/decode/build helpers + OrgAuthorizationResult + verifyOrgAuthorization seven-step verifier pipeline. The verifier reads the envelope's authorized_by leaf, looks up the named org self-declaration in knownOrgs, runs the shipped verifyDisclosureProof, confirms the cross-envelope binding via digest-equals-envelopeId, confirms the disclosed leaf name matches the claimed action, decodes the rule, and counts distinct eligible-signer signatures against threshold. Returns structured result rather than throwing. 19 new tests across 5 describe blocks bringing the file to 34 tests, including all four forgery-class fuzz cases flagged in the Phase A close-out (leaf-value, wrong-org-binding via same-subject-different-digest, tampered-path, tampered-meta) plus the action-claim mismatch case. Zero tapit-attest changes; no library version bump.

outcome.notes: [P-001] AuthorizedByPayload interface + encode/decode/build helpers added. [P-002] verifyOrgAuthorization seven-step pipeline implemented with structured-result return. [P-003] Cross-envelope binding check (proofResult.digest === envelopeId(orgSelfDecl)) catches the wrong-org-binding forgery class. [P-004] Action-claim mismatch check catches an attacker gluing one rule's proof onto a credential claiming a different action. [P-005] 19 new tests across 5 describe blocks; 34 tests total in createOrganization.test.ts. [P-006] All four forgery classes covered with dedicated tests. [P-007] connections/manifest.ts notes extended with Phase B paragraph. [P-008] All four gates green: typecheck, lint, 136/136 tests, build clean in 4.41s. [P-009] File-size warn fired louder: createOrganization.ts now 726 lines (74 below 800 hard limit). Recommend stating this non-negotiably in the Phase C dispatch brief.
